1.explanation: This example sets the DataTable's size prop to "tall" and applies getHeaderProps({ header }) only on the "Name" column, enabling sorting (and rendering the sort icon). Because the taller header row has extra vertical space, the text and icon in the sortable header cell shift position differently than the static labels in the other headers—demonstrating the misalignment bug.
1.bug_scenario: When using a "tall" DataTable with sorting enabled, the header labels become vertically misaligned: sortable headers (with a sort icon) sit lower than non-sortable headers, so the text is not consistently centered in the taller header bar (as shown in the screenshot).
